scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis elasticsearch
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop postgres redis elasticsearch
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose logs -f postgres redis elasticsearch
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WORKER,WEB -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w backend typecheck && npm run -w frontend build
scripts.build: npm run -w backend build && npm run -w frontend build
